atAGlance: Gà luộc is poached chicken, usually with lime-pepper salt, herbs, and sometimes sticky rice or porridge.
whatItIs: Gà luộc is poached chicken, usually served with rau răm, lime-pepper salt, and sometimes ginger fish sauce. The texture is firmer and cleaner than fried chicken.
howToEnjoy: Dip small pieces in lime-pepper salt and eat with herbs or rice. If it is free-range chicken, expect more chew and flavor.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà luộc when you want plain poached chicken for dipping. Ask for lime-pepper salt on the side or extra rau răm before the plate arrives.
worthKnowing: Poached chicken is a celebratory and family-table staple in Vietnam, especially when the chicken has good texture.
goodToKnow: Boiled chicken is often about clean chicken flavor, firm texture, and lime-pepper salt. Dip lightly so the salt and citrus lift the meat without covering it.
